company.description:
Play 3arabi is digital games publisher focused on Arabia - a region with more than 60 million smartphone gamers, 60 million active online players, rich and unique cultures, and home to the 5th most spoken language globally.

Play 3arabi plays a role in shaping today's industry in the region, and its future, and aims to spread a culture of play in Arabia.
